issue.failure: Assertion at line 85 expected scrollLeft >= initial + 50 after a 56px drag; line 86 similarly expected scrollTop >= initial + 26 after a 32px drag.
issue.diagnosis: The test preconditions allowed maxLeft > 40 and maxTop > 20. Therefore the fixed 50px and 26px thresholds could demand more scroll distance than the browser viewport had available (for ranges 41–49px and 21–25px). The hosted log did not expose the actual geometry, so the mismatch is a credible source of flakiness, not proof that this was the exact hosted geometry. No product-code defect was established.

change.summary: The pan assertion now requires the lesser of the pointer drag and available scroll range, with 2px browser rounding tolerance. It continues to require the full physically available movement and retains the checks that panning does not move nodes, alter the Page Model, Save, or Publish. Failure diagnostics now include initial, maximum, and final scroll offsets.
